notes.title: MacOS and Linux versions are out!
notes.content:
Now Mac and Linux users can join the battle against evil in the Donnington castle!

We remind you that there is a competition! Who is the first to find a secret room will receive a memorable gift from developers!

You can post a video confirmation to community hub!

notes.title: Steam achievements are out!
notes.content:
We finally added achievements to the game! Hurrah! I hope you enjoy them. If you have any difficulty in getting them - write to the community of the game, we check it often.
By the way, we brought in a secret level. Who is the first to find it - send a video confirmation, we will send you a memorable gift. )
The next step is the release of versions for MacOS, Linux.
Well and trade cards off course.

Thanks to all the players! Have a fun!
help@abberbury.com
